Lesson 9 · Articles
Lesson 9
Choosing the Right Article
Using a • an • the — Naturally
☕📖🏨
🎯 Get ready

Lesson Objectives

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

  • 1 Choose the correct article (a, an, the) in everyday situations.
  • 2 Understand when to use a, an, the, or no article.
  • 3 Recognize articles in conversations and short texts.
  • 4 Describe pictures using accurate articles.
  • 5 Speak more naturally and confidently.
🗣️ Warm-up

Let's Talk First

Tap a question to see a sample answer idea.

How often do you eat at a restaurant or café? ▸
Sample ideaI eat at a restaurant about once a week.
What is your favorite place to have coffee or dinner? ▸
Sample ideaMy favorite place is a small café near my house.
Have you ever ordered the wrong food by mistake? ▸
Sample ideaYes, once I ordered the wrong dish and it was too spicy!

🔍 Discovery Activity

Notice the Words

Don't think about grammar yet — just notice the bold words.

  • 1 Yesterday, I stopped at a café near my office before work.
  • 2 I ordered a sandwich and a cup of coffee.
  • 3 The waiter recommended an Italian dessert.
  • 4 The dessert was delicious.
  • 5 My friend ordered the same dessert.
  • 6 We walked to the museum across the street.
  • 7 We saw an artist painting outside the entrance.
🔍 Discovery Activity

Think About It

Discuss with your partner, then tap to check.

Why do we say a café, but the museum? ▸
Thinka café = first time we mention it. the museum = a specific one we both know.
Why do we say an artist, not a artist? ▸
ThinkBecause "artist" begins with a vowel sound.
Why do we say the same dessert? ▸
ThinkBecause it refers back to a dessert we already mentioned.
Can you guess when we use a, an, and the? ▸
ThinkLet's find out in the grammar section next!
📖 Grammar · 1 of 4

We Use "a"

Use a before a singular countable noun when we mention it for the first time.
  • ✓ I bought a new backpack yesterday.
  • ✓ She is looking for a job.
  • ✓ We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.
  • ✓ I need a charger for my phone.
  • ✓ He wants to buy a bicycle.
📖 Grammar · 2 of 4

We Use "an"

Use an before words that begin with a vowel sound.
  • ✓ She ate an apple after lunch.
  • ✓ We saw an elephant at the zoo.
  • ✓ He is an engineer.
  • ✓ I received an email this morning.
  • ✓ They stayed in an apartment near the city center.
💡 Listen to the sound, not just the first letter — an hour ✅ but a university ✅
📖 Grammar · 3 of 4

We Use "the"

Use the when the listener already knows which person or thing you mean.
  • ✓ I bought a book yesterday. The book is very interesting.
  • ✓ Please close the door.
  • ✓ Where is the manager?
  • ✓ We enjoyed the movie you recommended.
  • ✓ Could you pass me the salt?
📖 Grammar · 4 of 4

Sometimes No Article

We usually do not use a, an, or the with general ideas.
  • ✓ I drink coffee every morning.
  • ✓ Children learn quickly.
  • ✓ Life is full of surprises.
  • ✓ She goes to school by bus.
  • ✓ We usually have dinner at home.
💡 Quick Tips

Remember This

✅ First time → a / an — "I bought a laptop."
✅ Second time → the — "The laptop is very fast."

✍️ Exercise 3

Find the Rule

  • 1 Yesterday, I bought a camera.
  • 2 The camera takes amazing photos.
  • 3 My sister is an accountant.
  • 4 We visited the old market after lunch.
Which noun is mentioned for the first time? ▸
Answercamera — "a camera" in sentence 1.
Which noun is mentioned again? ▸
Answercamera — "the camera" in sentence 2.
Which word comes before accountant? ▸
Answeran
Why do we use an instead of a? ▸
AnswerBecause "accountant" begins with a vowel sound.

Find & Correct the Mistake

Each sentence has one mistake. Tap to see the fix.

📖 Exercise 8 · Reading

A Day With Friends

Tap each blank to reveal a, an, the, or (—).

Last Friday, my friends and I decided to spend the afternoon together. We found ___ small café near our university. ___ café had comfortable chairs and served excellent coffee.

After that, we visited ___ art exhibition in the city center. One friend bought ___ beautiful painting, and another spoke with ___ artist who created it.

Before going home, we stopped at ___ bookstore because I wanted ___ English novel my teacher recommended.

It was ___ enjoyable day, and we agreed to meet again next weekend.

📖 Exercise 8 · Reading Questions

Check Your Understanding

Where did the friends go first? ▸
AnswerThey went to a small café near their university.
What did one friend buy? ▸
AnswerA beautiful painting.
Who did another friend speak with? ▸
AnswerThe artist who created the painting.
Why did they visit the bookstore? ▸
AnswerBecause the narrator wanted an English novel their teacher recommended.
Did they enjoy the day? ▸
AnswerYes — it was an enjoyable day, and they agreed to meet again.

🎮 Online Game

Article Detective

The teacher shows a picture (a restaurant, an airport, a supermarket...). Students have 30 seconds to write as many correct sentences as possible using a, an, and the. Each correct article = 1 point!

Example — Restaurant:

  • ✓ A waiter is serving a customer.
  • ✓ The customer is reading the menu.
  • ✓ There is a bottle of water on the table.
  • ✓ An elderly couple is sitting near the window.
